title: State Funeral
text: “Honestly, Ren and Itsuki… why do they always try to outsmart everyone else…”
As he boarded the first ship leaving the next morning, my Father grumbled.
“My mother said the heroes summoned in the past had similar traits as well.”
“Ah… yeah. Maybe it’s a common trait among people from other worlds.”
“Exactly. I’ve had similar thoughts myself before.”
“It’s nothing but unpleasant for the person on the receiving end. And when you think about it, even if they do manage to outmaneuver you and do something, it’s probably nothing good.”
“That’s true.”

I’d wager Ren and Itsuki have headed toward the Spirit Tortoise, haven’t they? We declared we’d stop them at all costs. That’s why they’re probably trying to break the seal by catching us off guard. Indeed, the Spirit Tortoise’s invasion is likely advancing in secret in the area where it’s sealed.

However, it would be impossible for Ren and Itsuki in their current state to strike the Spirit Tortoise the moment it’s revived. Rather, once it’s revived, we should evacuate the residents of the country on the Spirit Tortoise’s back before breaking the seal. But it’s clear that Ren and Itsuki are going to break the seal without permission.
“Have you been able to contact the ship Ren and Itsuki boarded?”
“It’s a bit difficult since we’re on the open ocean.”
“So the problem is that once we leave the vicinity of Cal Mira Island, we can use portals even at sea…”
“That would allow for a significant shortcut.”
“That’s true. Still—”
Father turns his gaze toward the stern of the departing ship.
“Whoa—are we going to chase after that ship now?”
“That’s right. Well then, everyone, let’s follow Lord Motoyasu.”

Yuki-chan takes command at the stern and guides Filolial-sama and the others. I suggested we could just board the ship bound for Melromarc one by one, but since Filolial-sama and the others insisted on coming along, we ended up swimming to keep up with the moving ship. Everyone has started swimming after the ship, just like waterfowl.
“I can’t very well leave those kids behind on Cal Mira Island, can I…”
My Finacée’s eyes are sparkling as she watches Filolial-sama and the others following behind the ship.
“Wow… They’re trailing behind like the wake of a ship made of Filolials.”
“It reminds me more of the sight of toy ducks lined up in a row and floating down a river in my world back in the day.”
“It’s quite a bizarre sight, isn’t it?”
Filolial-sama and the others are swimming after the ship, looking like they’re having a great time. I’d like to join them, too.
“That’s pretty amazing. Just one look at this, and you can tell how hard that spear-wielding guy worked on Cal Mira Island.”
Keel was leaning against the ship’s railing, watching the scene.
“Anyway, let’s hurry up and catch up with Ren and Itsuki!”
“Let’s get going!”
“I don’t know about that…”
My father was scratching his cheek with his finger as he watched the scene.
“Hey, Motoyasu. Can’t we use a portal to travel?”
“It’d be pretty tough to move this many Filolial-samas all at once, I’m afraid.”
“Well… I guess so. If we just order them to meet up with us later…”
“Either way, we’ll have to move a fair distance to make it work.”
After we left the activation zone on Cal Mira Island, we decided to travel via portal from the ship. The Filolial-samas would follow along behind the ship.
“If Itsuki and Ren are still on the ship, we could hold them off by waiting at the port, but that’s just wishful thinking, isn’t it?”
“Indeed.”
“I think we should stop by Melromarc, where my mother is, first.”
My fiancée suggested. Certainly, we need to confirm where Ren and Itsuki have gone right now. I assume they’re heading toward the Spirit Tortoise, but who knows how things will turn out.
“Is the Land of the Spirit Tortoise closer from Melromarc? Or is it closer from Siltvelt?”
“They’re about the same distance.”
“Motoyasu, you don’t happen to have a portal to the sealed Land of the Spirit Tortoise, do you?”
“No, I don’t.”
“I figured… Even if catching up is our top priority, we should stop by Melromarc first. “Then let’s teleport to Melromarc Castle.”
“Understood!”
We used a portal to teleport to Melromarc Castle.

And when we arrived at Melromarc Castle, a nationwide funeral was being held throughout the kingdom. The town below the castle was deathly quiet, and a horse-drawn hearse was being transported toward the church.
“Wh… What? What’s this?”

This is strange. If my memory serves me correctly, there was no such event in the first world. The citizens are watching the hearse pass by, wiping away tears as they bid a reluctant farewell. The Queen is leading the procession from the front.
“Mother.”
My Finacée, accompanied by Father and Sakura-chan, rushes out to join the procession.
“The funeral is currently in progress.”
“I’m so… sorry. But… whose funeral is this?”

My Finacée and my Father both addressed the Queen with this question. Seeing my Father arrive seemed to move the citizens even more deeply, and they wiped away their tears. Sensing the situation, the Queen guided us—including my Father—to the carriage behind the hearse that was transporting us. The rest of us ran alongside the slowly moving carriage, straining to hear. Then, inside the carriage, she began to explain the situation.

“This funeral is for those who made the ultimate sacrifice during our country’s revolution, and for Eclair Seaetto, the beloved daughter of Seaetto, who served as a bridge of friendship between us and the Demi-Humans.”
Huh? That name sounds familiar.
“If I recall correctly, that surname… wasn’t that the noble who advocated for friendship with Demi-Humans in this country?”
Oh! That was indeed the name. Hmm? What ever happened to Éclair…? I’d completely forgotten about her.
“You seem to know quite a bit.”
“I picked it up during the revolutionary movement. If I remember correctly… there were rumors she was being held in the dungeon of Melromarc Castle…”

“Yes… She was arrested under the pretext of an absurd punishment—for the ‘crime’ of taking the law into her own hands against our country’s soldiers who were attempting a slave hunt—and after being tortured, her death was confirmed. A state funeral, presided over by the great Lady Seaetto, is currently underway.”
“Is… that so? Then, does that mean we didn’t have to attend?”
“Since you, the Heroes, are currently working for the sake of the world…”

My Father looks rather frustrated by the Queen’s words. The hearse rumbles on. Eventually, the funeral service was held at the church. It’s no longer the Three Heroes Church, though. Was it the Four Saints Sect? That person who appears to be a priest is offering a prayer.
“Finally, in accordance with the will left by Miss Seaetto, her remains will be transported to the Seaetto Domain, and I hereby declare this funeral concluded.”

The church bells rang out with a loud “Kaan!” Everyone in the town below, including my Father, Keel, my Finacée, and Filolial-sama, sensed the solemnity of the moment and observed a moment of silence. I joined them in silence as well.
It’s probably Éclair. Could she have died because I didn’t save her? But that doesn’t make sense. She was supposed to have been alive in the first world.
“Why did Éclair die?”
“Motoyasu-kun.”
On the way back to the castle after the funeral, I asked the Queen. But my Father stopped me, saying it was inappropriate.
“Father, Éclair was alive in the previous loop and in the first world, too.”
“Huh!?”
Father’s face turned pale. Yes, it’s only natural to think that Éclair died because of us.
“Could it be that she died as a result of us meddling… or something like that?”
